name: my_task
task: One or two sentences: what must be true in 1C Configurator at the end. Name the extension and objects exactly as they are shown on screen.
rules: What the agent must never touch. Example: Work only in the extension 'api'. Do not delete anything. Do not save the configuration.

subgoals.goal: ONE visible step: which element, where on the screen, what to do with it (click / right-click / set_field). Describe the element by its text and position.
subgoals.check: What must be visible on the screenshot after the step. Something the verifier can see, for example a window title or a new node in the tree.

subgoals.goal: Step that puts text into a field: use set_field on the value cell right of the label 'Имя' with the text my_name.
Step inside a menu: open the main menu 'Конфигурация' and click the item '...'.
